0022600108.text: The Wizards (1-0, 2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East) are on a one-game winning streak heading into their third game of the season, while the Bulls (1-1, 3rd in the Central, 0.5 games back, 8th in the East) have played two. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026.
